_about: Fish you can catch, and how fishing plays (see Fishing and the fishing close-up: CastAction, BiteAction, ReelAction). Each fish: habitat (pond or beach), seasons and hours (hour blocks from data/time.json) it bites in ([] = any), rarity (a key of rarity_weights: how often it's picked among the fish that are biting), size_cm [min, max], difficulty 0-1 (how hard it pulls, and how long it takes to reel in), color (and belly) for its model. Catches go to the kitchen's pantry (pantry_kind) and the Fish Log; they're never sold. The game doesn't track weather, so fish don't depend on it.

cast._about: Hold to charge (the bar goes up and back down every charge_seconds), let go to cast. Distances in meters from the bank. A hot spot (ripples) is somewhere in range: landing within hot_spot_radius of it gets a bite sooner.

bite._about: Seconds before the bite (times hot_spot_wait_factor in the ripples), how many fake nibbles come first, and how long the bobber stays under for you to strike.

reel._about: Tension 0-1. Reeling raises it (reel_rise a second at full), slack lets it fall (slack_fall). The fish pulls in bursts (pull_seconds long, pull_every apart), adding pull_strength a second (easy fish at the low end, hard fish at the high end) while you reel, but only slack_pull_share of it while you let go (the line runs out): so reeling through a hard pull snaps it. Above safe_high for snap_seconds (or at 1) the line snaps; below safe_low for escape_seconds the fish gets away. reel_speed: share of the way in per second of reeling in the safe band (hard fish times hard_fish_reel); outside it, reeling counts for off_band_reel of that.

fish.description: A wriggly bottom-dweller that comes up in the dark and the dawn.

fish.name: Common Carp
fish.description: Big, patient and strong. Takes a while to bring in.

fish.name: Catfish
fish.description: Whiskery and heavy. Wakes up when the sun goes down.

fish.name: Rainbow Trout
fish.description: A pink stripe down its side. Likes cold mornings.

fish.name: Golden Koi

fish.name: Moonlit Pike
fish.description: Silver-blue and fierce. Hunts on winter nights.
